links_and_groups: A work order supplies target scope and declared phase identity. Component and constraint models and target scope feed bounded context selection, which guides an agent but does not enforce every obligation. Lifecycle policy and reconciled observed phase state remain distinct inputs to selected dispatch checks; absence of completion evidence is not a positive DONE match. The implementing agent preserves durable artifacts. Completion review evaluates landed work and independent evidence before recording acceptance. Interrupted or unresolved work is inspected before reassignment.
